result.question: Capacidades completas de la API de Zenput (ahora "Crunchtime Ops Execution") — versiones v1, v2 y v3 — para un integrador que ya usa v3 (submissions, locations, teams, forms, activities) y quiere descubrir endpoints ADICIONALES útiles que no está usando. Contexto verificado empíricamente 2026-08: la base v3 https://www.zenput.com/api/v3/ funciona (estructura meta/data, auth header X-API-TOKEN); la mayoría de v1 /api/v1/ da 404 PERO el endpoint /api/v1/forms/list_templates/ SÍ responde 200 (estructura distinta success/status/results, con metadata rica: category_id/category_name, creator_full_name, permission_id, is_shared_form, num_submissions, date_last_submitted, is_secure). Investigar: (1) ¿Qué endpoints ofrecían oficialmente v1 y v2 de Zenput y cuáles siguen VIVOS en 2025-2026? Documentación histórica de developer.zenput.com / developer.crunchtime.com, y cualquier endpoint v1/v2 que aún funcione (ej. forms/list_templates, forms/list, scores, reports); estructura de respuesta y auth de v1 (X-API-TOKEN). (2) Capacidades de v3 que un integrador típicamente NO usa pero existen: endpoints de SCORES/calificaciones agregadas, REPORTS, form field definitions/schema (la estructura completa de un formulario con sus campos y secciones sin bajar submissions), CATEGORIES de formularios, projects/tasks/activities detallados, users con roles y teams, audit trail, media/photos, y cualquier endpoint de EXPORT masivo o Large Batch. (3) ¿Zenput/Crunchtime tiene WEBHOOKS o notificaciones push por API (para evitar polling) — documentados oficialmente o en la práctica? (4) Rate limits documentados, paginación (offset cap, cursores next_token, Large Batch para >10k). (5) Diferencias prácticas v1 vs v3: ¿v1 trae datos o campos que v3 no expone (ej. metadata de plantillas, scores pre-agregados, categorías)? y viceversa. Entregar: tabla de endpoints por versión (v1/v2/v3) con estado (vivo/muerto), qué datos/campos únicos ofrece cada uno, cuáles serían ÚTILES para un sistema de compliance tracking (scores agregados, categorías, field schemas, webhooks), y recomendaciones concretas de qué endpoints adicionales adoptar. Fuentes: developer.zenput.com, developer.crunchtime.com, support.crunchtime.com, foros/GitHub de integraciones Zenput, Postman collections públicas.
result.summary: Zenput (Crunchtime Ops Execution) API is request-response, X-API-TOKEN auth, no native webhooks (polling only). A v3 integrator should adopt Large Batch (over-10k export), v1 forms/list_templates (still live, rich template metadata v3 lacks), v3 hierarchy CRUD, Calendar Events, and media v2 storage. No API scores/reports endpoints; use UI Triggers plus polling.

findings.claim: ADOPT Large Batch POST /api/v3/submissions/batch/: beyond the 10,000-record limit, 2500 per call, next_token cursor via GET. Standard v3 List Submissions paginates offset/limit (max 100, default 20) with full next/previous URLs, so >10k needs Large Batch.
findings.evidence: Verbatim beyond the 10,000 record limit, 2500 at a time; reference max 100 default 20. 3-0.

findings.claim: ADOPT still-live v1 forms/list_templates (/api/v1/forms/list_templates/, results+status+success+count) exposing template metadata absent from v3 submissions: num_submissions, date_last_submitted, permission_id, creator_full_name, category. Also v3 hierarchy CRUD (User Roles, Users, Teams, Locations; DELETE=deactivate), Calendar Events (~2025 operating hours), and media v2 GET /api/v2/users/current/storage/?path= (24h URL, one per call).
findings.evidence: list_templates empirically 200 in 2026-08 while rest of v1 is 404; storage live per docs (not verified 200). 3-0.

findings.claim: NO native webhooks/push (per-device email/SMS/push only, llms.txt lists none, events need polling); substitute is UI Triggers (auto tasks/alerts on submission criteria, Reports/Forms tabs). Legacy v1 List Form Submissions dead since 2022-02-16; Forms API has four endpoints, no standalone field-schema/categories (schema from Retrieve Form Template). No API scores/reports endpoints; exact /api/v3/tasks path unconfirmed (refuted).
findings.evidence: llms.txt no webhooks; Triggers doc verbatim; legacy disabled 2022-02-16; four form GET endpoints. 3-0.

result.caveats: Live status for v1/v2 is from docs; only v1 forms/list_templates was empirically 200 in 2026-08. Storage v2 unverified (test before relying; other documented v1 endpoints 404). No API scores/reports endpoints (UI features); derive scores from submission fields or the PORCENTAJE formula field. Calendar Events month (~Sep 2025) and exact Tasks v3 path unconfirmed. No numeric rate limits documented; only throttle is the pagination cap (max 100, ~10k). support.crunchtime.com WebFetch returns 403; corroborated via cached snippets of official URLs.
openQuestions: Does storage v2 return 200 in the integrator's account or share the 404 of other v1 endpoints? Test with a real token.
Exact paths of Tasks, Sensors, FBC Assignments? /api/v3/tasks was refuted.
Observable rate limits (429, Retry-After) at production volume?
Are Calendar Events available in the integrator's plan and under which v3 path?

refuted.claim: This Forms Endpoints documentation does not document categories, scores, form schema-only endpoints, batch/export operations, rate limits, pagination, webhooks, or the rich template-metadata fields (is_shared_form, num_submissions, date_last_submitted) found in the v1 list_templates endpoint.

The Zenput developer documentation (as of the June 2025 update) does not explicitly list endpoint paths for scores, reports, webhooks, or media management — indicating these capabilities are either absent or undocumented in the public developer docs.

Zenput's Tasks API is served under the v3 API namespace with four documented operations: List (GET /api/v3/tasks), Retrieve (GET /api/v3/tasks/{id}), Create (POST /api/v3/tasks), and Update (PATCH /api/v3/tasks/{id}).
